rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the core test: DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with explicit reference levels (t0), per-coefficient interaction LFCs, and trajectory clustering to describe the pattern for significant genes. QC (blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap colored by condition/time, library sizes, explicit flag-not-drop policy), the minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the cell size), in-model median-of-ratios normalization, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, and apeglm shrinkage are all stated clearly; the salmon length-offset caveat and 3-replicate power caution are appropriate. The main weakness is enrichment: it was not asked for and the reference omits it, and ranking by the non-negative LRT chi-square statistic is an awkward metric for preranked GSEA (no directional information), although the collections, versions, size window and full-list input are otherwise well specified. The report section is complete, naming method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, diagnostics and caveats.
